text_block_list.text:
One day, I ran into Hishi Miracle, but she kept
looking behind her. Wondering what was going on,
I took a look...
Symboli Kris S was staring intently at Hishi Miracle with sharp eyes.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I didn't do anything, you know?!
It's just~...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "I want you to tell me how you spend your time... normally... at the Academy."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
? Ah, umm, how I spend my time at the academy?
...Why do you wanna know that?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —To revitalize the Japanese racing scene. For that mission—I need to know what's "Usual."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: For stuff like that, wouldn't someone like Yaeno-chan be way more suited than me—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Different from... average.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah...... Maybe so.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...So, well, that's how it is.
They apparently want to watch and learn from my daily routine."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "And so, I've been watched the whole time... From just a bit behind me......"

It doesn't seem like a big deal. Besides,
she's usually so laid-back.
This might actually give her routine some nice contrast.

I spotted Hishi Miracle during lunchtime.
Seeing how she wasn't looking over her shoulder,
I wondered if that observation period of hers had ended...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Nothing looks good to me...
I think I'll skip the cafe today.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: So, what do you wanna do? Grab some bread or something?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Let's hit the store.
Hope they still have some carrot bread left~.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――? Lunch...
weren't we planning to eat at a café?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Why—switch to the school store?
—What was the point of coming here?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I don't know.
It seems Symboli Kris S is getting swept along by Hishi Miracle's laid-back pace.

On this day, Hishi Miracle didn't show up
at the track even when it was time to train. Just then—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —A message from Hishi Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"‘I'm not really in the mood, so maybe not today~’
—apparently, that's what she said."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Hishi Miracle.
Message—delivered.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: A message...? What kind of message?
choice_data_list: 'Not really feeling it, so maybe I'll pass today~'

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer?!
N-No, you've got it wrong! That wasn't a message, it was...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Was I mistaken? Because you addressed me, I presumed it was a—message—my error.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, no, please don't apologize...
This is, well, how should I put it...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You know how when you're on a diet and see delicious sweets,
you just want to grab a bite?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And if I bottle up my feelings and hold back, I just end up
wanting to eat even more, and then I can't concentrate...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
At times like that, being honest with yourself and eating
just a little bit gives you both peace of mind and focus.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's why I was late to training today.
I did give it some thought in my own way~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Spending time relaxed, without pressure or pretense...
That's what it means to spend time nor~mally!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Without overthinking it, you say?
Then I have gotten in your way—my apologies.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, as long as you understand,
that's all that matters~.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Ah, that was quite informative.
choice_data_list: I don't think you should take that as much of a reference.
Could you keep keeping an eye on me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah.
I have no intention—of taking slacking off as a reference.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~...
Guess that means I'm off the hook then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"—No. Aside from that—it serves as good reference.
I shall—continue my observation."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, keep going!? Not to toot my own horn,
but you really shouldn't take cues from me!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, really, that would be an imposition.
Don't you have things to do too, Kris S-chan?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—It is for the sake of the mission.
Let us create a manageable schedule—one that allows for surveillance.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Man... I really think you should put a little more thought into how you spend your free time~

Maybe this amount of pressure
is actually better for Hishi Miracle.
